output.text:
One copper beetle, wiggling low,
Tiptoeing through the moonlit glow!
Two velvet moths, soft as a sigh,
Dancing in the night sky high!
Three sleepy stars, blinking slow,
Hiding their light, letting dreams grow.
One copper beetle, two velvet moths, three sleepy stars—
A tiny nighttime parade, just for us, and no more!
